title: The 1904 Nobel citation credits Pavlov for the physiology of digestion
summary: The Nobel Foundation's 1904 motivation is Pavlov's work on the physiology of digestion. The motivation sentence does not mention conditioned reflexes.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1904 says Ivan Pavlov received the prize in physiology or medicine in recognition of his work on the physiology of digestion, through which knowledge of vital aspects of the subject was transformed and enlarged. The record dates the award 20 October 1904. The motivation text that was read is about digestion. It does not mention conditioned reflexes, bells, or learning. This card does not move the prize onto a different subject.
